Name: The Everything Bagel
Author: SiTheGreat1
Description:
I don't know what inspired me to make this beyond a general frustration at the name of the so-called "everything bagel".
So I made my own!
Can you cook it?
(Sure you can. I believe in you!)
The ingredients list may vanish offscreen, making it hard to tell what all you need, so here are some hints:[spoiler]
[list]
[*]All ingredients are some form of food
[*]Very few are artisan goods
[*]No legendary fish (or their Qi challenge counterparts) are needed[/spoiler]
[/list][b]Perfection[/b]:
You can exclude the bagel recipe from being required for Perfection by installing rokugin's [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/31247]Perfection Exclusions[/url] mod.
This mod only works on 1.6 saves, not 1.5.

[url=https://www.pcgamer.com/games/life-sim/stardew-valley-modder-challenges-players-with-an-everything-bagel-recipe-that-requires-134-ingredients/]Yall my silly little mod was featured on PC Gamer XD[/url]

Downloads.Description: Added 1.6 ingredients at long last; also added recipe to Saloon shop, and now recipe won't be counted for perfection if rokugin's Perfection Exclusions mod is installed

Manifest.Description: Make a bagel using every ingredient in the game!
